answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital island of integrity for decentralized AI networks, requiring cryptographic attestation to verify uniqueness. Much like a zephyr shifts the landscape, this mechanism forces an attacker to wander through the costly process of acquiring verified biometric or social graph data for every node. By tethering computational influence to scarce biological identity rather than mere processing power, the protocol ensures that scaling an attack carries a prohibitive financial burden.
